non_advice_notice: This ledger is engineering source metadata for local linter research only. It is not legal advice, audit evidence, certification evidence, or a compliance determination.
client_claim_policy: No Pancakes output may claim certification, audit completion, compliance, attestation readiness, or legal sufficiency from this lane.
copying_policy: Do not copy licensed or paywalled standard text into Pancakes. Store only source metadata, original engineering summaries, local predicate notes, and citation pointers.
profile_gate_policy: Every standards-derived finding must stay advisory until a manual candidate decision records a deterministic local predicate, profile gates, client-safe wording, and fixture plans.

standards.title: PCI DSS v4.0.1
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only local blueprint evidence such as payment-data transport, storage, logging, or exposure signals that are visible without assessor interpretation.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only to identify candidate local checks around payment-data handling. Do not claim PCI DSS compliance or assessment completion.

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only locally visible evidence-management and risk-treatment proxy checks. Do not copy clauses, controls, annex text, or ISO content into prompts or runtime data.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only for high-level information-security management context. Do not copy standard clauses or claim ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27002:2022
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only original local proxy checks for security-control themes visible in automation artifacts. Do not copy control text or treat guidance as certifiable.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only for high-level security-control research. Do not copy control text or claim certification because ISO/IEC 27002 is guidance.

standards.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 General Data Protection Regulation
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only local personal-data exposure, retention, redaction, or transfer signals that can be detected without legal interpretation.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only to identify candidate local checks around personal-data exposure. Do not provide legal advice or claim GDPR compliance.

standards.title: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only trust-control review prompts for local evidence, change, access, availability, confidentiality, and privacy proxy checks. Do not claim attestation, readiness, or report issuance.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only to identify candidate local checks around controls evidence. Do not claim SOC 2 readiness, attestation, or audit completion.

standards.title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only local cybersecurity risk-management proxy checks with explicit profile gates. Do not claim CSF adoption or outcome achievement.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only for cybersecurity risk-management candidate research. Do not claim framework adoption or outcome achievement.

standards.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 5.0.0
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only local application-security proxy checks derived as original predicates. Do not claim ASVS level achievement or OWASP accreditation.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only to identify candidate local application-security checks. Do not claim ASVS verification unless a separate reviewed process exists.

standards.title: OWASP API Security Top 10 2023
standards.local_predicate_boundary: Use only local API-risk proxy checks visible in automation blueprints. Do not claim API security certification or assessment completion.
standards.engineering_use_boundary: Use only to identify candidate local API-risk checks. Do not claim API security certification or assessment completion.
